It is useful for linking related objects within the CRM, enabling better data organization and relationship tracking.

fromObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the source object for the association.

objects.list.title: List
objects.list.description: List Read a page of appointments. Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

objectType.description: The type of object to retrieve, such as contacts, companies, deals, etc.

after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

associations.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

properties.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of appointments that can be read by a single request.

objects.create.title: Create
objects.create.description: Create Create a appointment with the given properties and return a copy of the object, including the ID. Documentation and examples for creating standard appointments is provided.

objectType.description: The type of CRM object to create, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

items.description: Represents the associations for a specific object in HubSpot, detailing the types of associations and the related objects involved.

associations.description: An array of associations that link this object to other objects. Each association is defined using the PublicAssociationsForObject schema.

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs where the key is the property name and the value is the property value. Each property is represented as a string.

objects.batch.archive.title: Archive a batch of appointments by ID
objects.batch.archive.description: Archive a batch of appointments by ID Archive multiple appointments using their IDs.

objectType.description: The type of CRM object to archive in batch, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

items.description: Contains the Id of a Public Object

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectId objects, each containing a unique identifier for a CRM object. This property is required.

objects.batch.create.title: Create a batch of appointments
objects.batch.create.description: Create a batch of appointments Create multiple appointments in a single request.

objectType.description: The type of CRM object to create in batch. This specifies the category of objects being created, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

items.description: An input object that contains a collection of objects to be created together in a batch.

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectBatchInputForCreate objects, each containing the properties and associations needed to create a single CRM object.

objects.batch.read.title: Read a batch of appointments by internal ID, or unique property values
objects.batch.read.description: Read a batch of appointments by internal ID, or unique property values Retrieve records by record ID or include the `idProperty` parameter to retrieve records by a custom unique value property.

objectType.description: The type of CRM object to read in batch, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

idProperty.description: When using a custom unique value property to retrieve records, the name of the property. Do not include this parameter if retrieving by record ID.

items.description: Contains the Id of a Public Object

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectId objects, each containing an ID of the object to be read.

properties.description: An array of strings representing the properties to be returned in the response. If any specified properties are not present on the requested objects, they will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: An array of strings indicating the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any specified properties are not present on the requested objects, they will be ignored.

objects.batch.update.title: Update a batch of appointments by internal ID, or unique property values
objects.batch.update.description: Update a batch of appointments by internal ID, or unique property values Update a batch of CRM objects of a specified type in HubSpot. This endpoint allows you to modify multiple objects in a single request, making it efficient for bulk updates. The request body must include the objects and their properties to be updated.

objectType.description: The type of CRM object to update, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

items.description: Contains an array of CRM object records to be processed in a batch operation, each defined by their ID and properties.

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectBatchInput objects, each containing the properties of a single object to be updated. This array allows multiple objects to be updated in a single request.

objects.batch.upsert.title: Create or update a batch of appointments by unique property values
objects.batch.upsert.description: Create or update a batch of appointments by unique property values Create or update records identified by a unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. `idProperty` query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object.

objectType.description: The type of CRM object to be upserted, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

items.description: Represents an object used in batch upsert operations, containing an object’s unique identifier, its properties, and optionally the unique property name and a write trace ID.

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectBatchInputUpsert objects, each representing an object to be upserted. These objects contain the properties and identifiers needed for the upsert operation.

objects.gdpr-delete.title: GDPR-delete an object
objects.gdpr-delete.description: GDPR-delete an object Fully purge an object type and any GDPR related data

objectType.description: The type of CRM object to be deleted, such as 'contacts'.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object

objectId.description: The unique identifier of the object to be fully purged along with any GDPR-related data.

objects.merge.title: Merge objects
objects.merge.description: Merge objects Merge two object types together

objectType.description: The type of the CRM objects to merge, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

objectIdToMerge.description: The object ID to merge with the primary object.

primaryObjectId.description: The object ID of the primary object to merge.

objects.search.title: Search
objects.search.description: Search Search for appointments based on specified criteria. Learn more about [CRM search](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/guides/api/crm/search#make-a-search-request).

objectType.description: The type of CRM object to search for, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

after.description: A string representing the paging cursor token to retrieve results after a specific point.

items.description: Represents a group of filters used to query data within HubSpot. This component is used to define criteria for filtering records in various API endpoints.

filterGroups.description: An array of FilterGroup objects that define the filtering criteria for the search.

limit.description: An integer specifying the maximum number of results to return.

properties.description: An array of strings indicating which properties should be included in the search results.

query.description: A string representing the search query to be applied across the specified properties.

sorts.description: An array of strings specifying the properties by which the search results should be sorted.

objects.get.title: Read
objects.get.description: Read Read an Object identified by `{appointmentId}`. `{appointmentId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

objectId.description: The unique identifier of the object to read.

objectType.description: The type of the object to read.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

associations.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

objects.delete.title: Archive
objects.delete.description: Archive Move an Object identified by `{appointmentId}` to the recycling bin.

objectId.description: The unique identifier of the object to be archived.

objectType.description: The type of the object to be archived, such as contacts, companies, deals, etc.

objects.update.title: Update
objects.update.description: Update Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{appointmentId}`or optionally a unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. `{appointmentId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, and the `idProperty` query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will result in an error. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

objectId.description: The unique identifier of the object to update.

objectType.description: The type of the object to update.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs where each key is a property name and each value is the property's new value. All properties are strings.

objects.associations.list.title: List associations
objects.associations.list.description: List associations Retrieve associated object IDs for a given object type.

objectId.description: The unique identifier of the object for which associations are being listed.

objectType.description: The type of the object for which associations are being listed.

toObjectType.description: The type of the object to which associations are being listed.

after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

objects.associations.replace.title: Create Association
objects.associations.replace.description: Create Association Set association labels between two records in the CRM. This endpoint allows you to define relationships between different object types by specifying association labels. It is useful for organizing and managing interconnected data within your HubSpot account.

objectId.description: The unique identifier of the source object for which the association is being created.

objectType.description: The type of the source object for which the association is being created.

toObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the target object to be associated.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object to be associated.

objects.associations.delete.title: Delete
objects.associations.delete.description: Delete Delete all associations between two specified records in the CRM. This operation is useful when you need to remove the relationship between two objects, such as contacts or deals, without deleting the objects themselves.

objectId.description: The unique identifier of the source object from which associations are to be deleted.

objectType.description: The type of the source object from which associations are to be deleted.

toObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the target object to which associations are to be deleted.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object to which associations are to be deleted.

associations.definitions.configurations..title: Retrieve all association limits
associations.definitions.configurations..description: Retrieve all association limits Retrieve all configured association limits between objects, which include details about how different CRM object types are associated with each other.

associations.definitions.configurations..title: Retrieve association limits
associations.definitions.configurations..description: Retrieve association limits Retrieve the configuration details for associations between two specified CRM object types. Use this endpoint to understand limits that have been set for specific association types.

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object for the association.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object for the association.

associations.definitions.configurations..title: Configure association limits
associations.definitions.configurations..description: Configure association limits Batch configure association limits between two object types.

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object in the association.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object in the association.

inputs.description: An array of PublicAssociationDefinitionConfigurationCreateRequest objects. Each item in the array specifies the configuration details for creating an association definition.

associations.definitions.configurations..title: Remove association limits
associations.definitions.configurations..description: Remove association limits Batch delete limits that have been defined for association types between two object types.

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object from which the associations are being purged.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object to which the associations are being purged.

inputs.description: An array of PublicAssociationSpec objects, each defining the specifications for an association. This property is required and allows multiple association specifications to be processed in a single batch operation.

associations.definitions.configurations..title: Update association limits
associations.definitions.configurations..description: Update association limits Batch update association limits that have been configured between two object types.

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object in the association.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object in the association.

inputs.description: An array of PublicAssociationDefinitionConfigurationUpdateRequest objects. Each object in the array specifies the configuration details to be updated.

associations.labels.list.title: Retrieve association labels
associations.labels.list.description: Retrieve association labels Retrieve all labels that describe the relationships between two specified CRM object types. These labels provide context about the nature of the associations.

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object for the association.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object for the association.

associations.labels.replace.title: Update association label
associations.labels.replace.description: Update association label Update an existing label that describes the relationship between two specified CRM object types. This allows for modifications to existing association labels to better reflect the nature of the relationship.

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object in the association.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object in the association.

associationTypeId.description: The unique identifier for the association type.

inverseLabel.description: An optional descriptor for the inverse relationship between associated records.

label.description: A descriptor that provides context about the relationship between associated records.

associations.labels.create.title: Create association label
associations.labels.create.description: Create association label Create a new label that describes the relationship between two specified CRM object types. This can help in categorizing and managing associations more effectively.

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object in the association.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object in the association.

inverseLabel.description: An optional descriptor that clarifies the reverse relationship in the association.

label.description: A descriptor that provides context about the relationship between two associated CRM objects.

name.description: The unique identifier for the association definition.

associations.labels.delete.title: Delete association label
associations.labels.delete.description: Delete association label Remove a specific label from the association between two CRM object types.

associationTypeId.description: The unique identifier of the association type to delete.

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object in the association.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object in the association.

associations.usage.high-usage-report.cre.title: Report high usage
associations.usage.high-usage-report.cre.description: Report high usage Requests a report of all objects in the portal which have a high usage of associations

userId.description: The unique identifier of the user requesting the report. This is an integer value.

associations.batch.archive.title: Remove associations
associations.batch.archive.description: Remove associations Batch delete associations for objects

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object from which associations will be deleted.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object to which associations will be deleted.

inputs.description: An array of PublicAssociationMultiArchive objects, each specifying the associations to be archived. This is a required field.

associations.batch.associate.default.cre.title: Create Default Associations
associations.batch.associate.default.cre.description: Create Default Associations Create the default (most generic) association type between two object types

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object for the association.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object for the association.

inputs.description: An array of PublicDefaultAssociationMultiPost objects, each specifying the details of the default association to be created between two objects. This property is required.

associations.batch.create.title: Associate records (labelled)
associations.batch.create.description: Associate records (labelled) Batch create associations for objects

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object for the associations.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object for the associations.

inputs.description: An array of PublicAssociationMultiPost objects, each specifying the details of an association to be created. This includes the source and target objects and the types of associations to be applied.

associations.batch.labels.archive.title: Delete Specific Labels
associations.batch.labels.archive.description: Delete Specific Labels Batch delete specific association labels for objects. Deleting an unlabeled association will also delete all labeled associations between those two objects

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object in the association.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object in the association.

inputs.description: An array of PublicAssociationMultiPost objects, each specifying the details of an association to be created. This includes the source and target objects and the types of associations to be applied.

associations.batch.read.title: Retrieve associations
associations.batch.read.description: Retrieve associations Batch read associations for objects to specific object type. The 'after' field in a returned paging object can be added alongside the 'id' to retrieve the next page of associations from that objectId. The 'link' field is deprecated and should be ignored. Note: The 'paging' field will only be present if there are more pages and absent otherwise.

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object from which associations are being read.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object to which associations are being read.

inputs.description: An array of PublicFetchAssociationsBatchRequest objects, each specifying the details for fetching associations for a particular object. This property is required.

extensions.calling.inbound-call.create.title: Submit details of an inbound call to the CRM.
extensions.calling.inbound-call.create.description: Submit details of an inbound call to the CRM. This endpoint allows you to submit information about an inbound call to the CRM system. The request must include details such as the external call ID, call status, and involved phone numbers. This operation helps in logging and managing inbound call data within the CRM.

callStartedTimestamp.description: The timestamp indicating when the call started, formatted as a date-time string.

createEngagement.description: Indicates whether an engagement should be created for the call.

durationSeconds.description: The duration of the call in seconds.

engagementProperties.description: Contains additional properties related to the engagement.

externalCallId.description: The unique identifier for the call from an external system.

finalCallStatus.description: The final status of the call, with accepted values including: BUSY, CALLING_CRM_USER, CANCELED, COMPLETED, CONNECTING, FAILED, HOLD, IN_PROGRESS, MISSED, NO_ANSWER, QUEUED, RINGING, UNKNOWN.

userId.description: The ID of the user associated with the call.

extensions.calling.recordings.ready.crea.title: Mark a call recording as ready for retrieval.

engagementId.description: The unique identifier for the engagement associated with the call recording.

You can control the data returned by specifying certain properties, associations, and whether to include archived records. This endpoint is useful for fetching a list of objects with specific attributes and associations.

after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

associations.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

properties.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

objects.products.create.title: Create
objects.products.create.description: Create Create a CRM object with the specified properties and return a copy of the object, including its ID. This endpoint allows you to create standard objects in your HubSpot account, providing documentation and examples for guidance.

items.description: Represents the associations for a specific object in HubSpot, detailing the types of associations and the related objects involved.

associations.description: An array of associations that link this object to other objects. Each association specifies the target object and the types of associations to be created.

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs where each key is a property name and each value is the property's value. These properties define the attributes of the CRM object being created.

objects.products.batch.archive.title: Batch archive objects
objects.products.batch.archive.description: Batch archive objects Archive a batch of CRM objects by their IDs. This endpoint is useful for managing large sets of objects that need to be archived simultaneously. The operation does not return any content upon success, indicating that the objects have been successfully archived.

items.description: Contains the Id of a Public Object

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectId objects, each representing the ID of a public object to be processed in the batch operation.

objects.products.batch.create.title: Batch create objects
objects.products.batch.create.description: Batch create objects Create a batch of CRM objects with the specified properties. This endpoint allows for the creation of multiple objects in a single request, which can be useful for efficiently importing large datasets or synchronizing data from external systems. The response includes the created objects with their IDs.

items.description: An input object that contains a collection of objects to be created together in a batch.

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectBatchInputForCreate objects, each containing the properties and associations needed to create a single CRM object.

objects.products.batch.read.title: Batch read objects
objects.products.batch.read.description: Batch read objects Read a batch of CRM objects by their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint is useful for retrieving multiple objects in a single request, allowing for efficient data fetching. You can specify whether to include archived objects in the results.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

idProperty.description: When using a custom unique value property to retrieve records, the name of the property. Do not include this parameter if retrieving by record ID.

items.description: Contains the Id of a Public Object

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectId objects representing the IDs of the objects to be read.

properties.description: An array of strings representing the properties to be returned in the response. If a specified property is not present on the requested objects, it will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: An array of strings representing the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If a specified property is not present on the requested objects, it will be ignored.

objects.products.batch.update.title: Update batch objects
objects.products.batch.update.description: Update batch objects Update a batch of CRM objects in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to update multiple objects of a specified type by providing their properties in the request body. It's useful for making bulk updates to objects without having to update them individually.

items.description: Contains an array of CRM object records to be processed in a batch operation, each defined by their ID and properties.

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectBatchInput items, each containing the properties and identifiers necessary for updating a specific CRM object.

objects.products.batch.upsert.title: Upsert batch objects
objects.products.batch.upsert.description: Upsert batch objects Create or update a batch of CRM objects by unique property values. This endpoint allows for efficient management of multiple objects in a single request, ensuring that each object is either created or updated based on its unique identifiers.

items.description: Represents an object used in batch upsert operations, containing an object’s unique identifier, its properties, and optionally the unique property name and a write trace ID.

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectBatchInputUpsert objects. Each object in the array contains the properties and identifiers needed for the upsert operation.

objects.products.gdpr-delete.title: GDPR Delete
objects.products.gdpr-delete.description: GDPR Delete Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to comply with GDPR regulations. This endpoint allows you to identify a contact by their email address using the optional 'idProperty' set to 'email'. If the email address is not found, it will be added to a blocklist to prevent future use.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object

objectId.description: The unique identifier of the object to be deleted. This is a required string property.

objects.products.merge.title: Merge objects
objects.products.merge.description: Merge objects Merge two CRM objects of the same type within your HubSpot account. This operation combines the properties of the specified objects into a single object, retaining the primary object's ID. This is useful for consolidating duplicate records and maintaining a clean and organized CRM database.

objectIdToMerge.description: The unique identifier of the object that will be merged into the primary object. This is a string.

primaryObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the primary object that will remain after the merge. This is a string.

objects.products.search.title: Search
objects.products.search.description: Search Search for CRM objects of a specified type using various filters and criteria. This endpoint allows you to retrieve a collection of objects based on search parameters defined in the request body. It is useful for finding specific records that match certain conditions within your HubSpot account.

items.description: Represents a group of filters used to query data within HubSpot. This component is used to define criteria for filtering records in various API endpoints.

filterGroups.description: An array of filter groups used to refine the search results. Each filter group contains a set of filters that are applied together.

limit.description: An integer indicating the maximum number of results to return.

properties.description: An array of strings specifying which properties of the objects should be returned in the search results.

query.description: A string representing the search query to be applied.

sorts.description: An array of strings specifying the sorting order of the search results.

objects.products.get.title: Read
objects.products.get.description: Read Read an object identified by `objectId`. The `objectId` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query parameter. You can control the response content by specifying desired properties using the `properties` query parameter.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

objects.products.delete.title: Archive
objects.products.delete.description: Archive Move an Object identified by `{objectId}` to the recycling bin. This operation allows you to archive a specific CRM object by its unique identifier, effectively removing it from active use while retaining it in the system for potential recovery or auditing purposes.

objects.products.update.title: Update
objects.products.update.description: Update Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{objectId}`. `{objectId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs where keys are property names and values are the corresponding property values. Each property value is a string.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app for which to retrieve the cards. It must be an integer.

extensions.cards-dev.create.title: Create a new card
extensions.cards-dev.create.description: Create a new card Defines a new card that will become active on an account when this app is installed.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the card is being created. This is an integer value.

title.description: The top-level title for this card. Displayed to users in the CRM UI.

extensions.cards-dev.views.migrate.creat.title: Migrate Card Views
extensions.cards-dev.views.migrate.creat.description: Migrate Card Views Swaps a Legacy CRM Card with an App Card in views. Reference the "Migrate a legacy CRM card to an app card" docs for more information

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app for which views are being migrated.

allowDuplicateAppCardIds.description: A boolean flag indicating whether duplicate app card IDs are allowed during the migration process.

appCardId.description: The unique identifier for the new app card to which views will be migrated. This is an integer in int64 format.

helpdeskAppCardId.description: The unique identifier for the helpdesk app card, if applicable. This is an integer in int64 format.

legacyCrmCardId.description: The unique identifier for the legacy CRM card. This is an integer in int64 format.

extensions.cards-dev.get.cardid.title: Get a card.
extensions.cards-dev.get.cardid.description: Get a card. Returns the definition for a card with the given ID.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app associated with the card. This should be an integer.

cardId.description: The unique identifier of the card to retrieve.

extensions.cards-dev.delete.title: Delete a card
extensions.cards-dev.delete.description: Delete a card Permanently deletes a card definition with the given ID. Once deleted, data fetch requests for this card will no longer be sent to your service. This can't be undone.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the application associated with the card.

cardId.description: The unique identifier of the card to delete.

extensions.cards-dev.update.title: Update a card
extensions.cards-dev.update.description: Update a card Update a card definition with new details.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app associated with the card.

cardId.description: The unique identifier of the card to update.

title.description: The top-level title for this card. Displayed to users in the CRM UI.

feature-flags.flags.all.get.title: List Flags
feature-flags.flags.all.get.description: List Flags Retrieve all feature flags associated with a specific application in your HubSpot account. This endpoint is useful for developers who need to manage or audit feature flags for their applications. It requires the application ID to identify which application's flags to list.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the application for which to retrieve all feature flags.

feature-flags.flags.get.title: Retrieve an app's feature flags
feature-flags.flags.get.description: Retrieve an app's feature flags Retrieve the current status of the app's feature flags. No request body is included.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app associated with the feature flag.

flagName.description: The name of the feature flag to retrieve.

feature-flags.flags.replace.title: Set an app's feature flag
feature-flags.flags.replace.description: Set an app's feature flag Set a feature flag for an app. For example, update the `hs-hide-crm-cards` flag's `defaultState` to `ON` to hide classic CRM cards from new installs.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the application associated with the feature flag.

flagName.description: The name of the feature flag to update.

defaultState.description: The state that the flag should have if there are no overrides for a particular portal

overrideState.description: A flag value that supercedes all other overrides, including portal-level values. Mostly used for things like emergency overrides

feature-flags.flags.delete.title: Delete an app's feature flag
feature-flags.flags.delete.description: Delete an app's feature flag Delete a feature flag in an app. For example, delete the `hs-release-app-cards` flag after all accounts have been migrated.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the application from which the feature flag will be deleted.

flagName.description: The name of the feature flag to be deleted.

feature-flags.flags.portals.get.title: Retrieve accounts with a set flag state
feature-flags.flags.portals.get.description: Retrieve accounts with a set flag state Retrieve a list of HubSpot accounts with an account-level flag setting for the specified app. No request body is included.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app associated with the feature flag.

flagName.description: The name of the feature flag to retrieve portal information for.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

startPortalId.description: The ID of the portal to start the list from. Useful for pagination.

feature-flags.flags.portals.batch.delete.title: Batch delete account flag state
feature-flags.flags.portals.batch.delete.description: Batch delete account flag state Delete an account-level flag state for multiple HubSpot accounts at once. Use this endpoint to manage flag exposure for groups of HubSpot accounts.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the application associated with the feature flag.

flagName.description: The name of the feature flag to be deleted.

portalIds.description: An array of integers representing the unique identifiers of the portals for which the feature flag states are to be deleted.

feature-flags.flags.portals.batch.upsert.title: Batch set account flag state
feature-flags.flags.portals.batch.upsert.description: Batch set account flag state Set the portal flag state for multiple HubSpot accounts at once. Use this endpoint to manage flag exposure for groups of HubSpot accounts.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the feature flags are being managed.

flagName.description: The name of the feature flag to upsert.

portalStates.description: An array of portal flag state entries to be updated. Each entry contains details about the portal ID and the desired flag state.

feature-flags.flags.portals.get.portalid.title: Retrieve account flag state
feature-flags.flags.portals.get.portalid.description: Retrieve account flag state Retrieve the account-level flag state of a specific HubSpot account.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app containing the feature flag.

flagName.description: The name of the feature flag to retrieve.

portalId.description: The unique identifier of the portal for which the flag state is being retrieved.

feature-flags.flags.portals.replace.title: Set an account flag state
feature-flags.flags.portals.replace.description: Set an account flag state Specify an account-level flag state for a specific HubSpot account.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the application associated with the feature flag.

flagName.description: The name of the feature flag to update.

portalId.description: The unique identifier of the portal where the feature flag state is being updated.

flagState.description: The state that the given flag should be in for this portal

feature-flags.flags.portals.delete.title: Delete an account flag state
feature-flags.flags.portals.delete.description: Delete an account flag state Delete an account-level flag state for a specific HubSpot account. No request body is included.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app associated with the feature flag.

flagName.description: The name of the feature flag to delete.

portalId.description: The unique identifier of the portal from which the feature flag will be deleted.

objects.quotes.list.title: List
objects.quotes.list.description: List Read a page of quotes. Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

associations.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

properties.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

objects.quotes.create.title: Create
objects.quotes.create.description: Create Create a quote with the given properties and return a copy of the object, including the ID. Documentation and examples for creating standard quotes is provided.

items.description: Represents the associations for a specific object in HubSpot, detailing the types of associations and the related objects involved.

associations.description: An array of associations that link this object to other objects. Each association is defined by a 'PublicAssociationsForObject' schema.

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs where keys are property names and values are the corresponding property values for the CRM object. Each property value is a string.

objects.quotes.batch.archive.title: Archive a batch of quotes by ID
objects.quotes.batch.archive.description: Archive a batch of quotes by ID Archive multiple quotes by their IDs in a single request, effectively moving them to the recycling bin.

items.description: Contains the Id of a Public Object

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectId objects, each representing a unique identifier for a CRM object. This property is required and is used to specify the objects involved in the batch operation.

objects.quotes.batch.create.title: Create a batch of quotes
objects.quotes.batch.create.description: Create a batch of quotes Create multiple quotes in a single request by providing a batch of quote objects, each with its own properties and optional associations.

items.description: An input object that contains a collection of objects to be created together in a batch.

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectBatchInputForCreate objects, each containing the properties and associations needed to create a new CRM object.

objects.quotes.batch.read.title: Read a batch of quotes by internal ID, or unique property values
objects.quotes.batch.read.description: Read a batch of quotes by internal ID, or unique property values Retrieve records by record ID or include the `idProperty` parameter to retrieve records by a custom unique value property.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

idProperty.description: When using a custom unique value property to retrieve records, the name of the property. Do not include this parameter if retrieving by record ID.

items.description: Contains the Id of a Public Object

inputs.description: An array of objects, each containing an 'id' field, representing the CRM objects to be read.

properties.description: An array of property names to be returned in the response. Each element is a string representing a property name.

propertiesWithHistory.description: An array of property names for which the history of previous values should be returned. Each element is a string representing a property name.

objects.quotes.batch.update.title: Update a batch of quotes by internal ID, or unique property values
objects.quotes.batch.update.description: Update a batch of quotes by internal ID, or unique property values Update multiple quotes using their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint allows batch processing of quote updates, ensuring efficient management of multiple records in a single request.

items.description: Contains an array of CRM object records to be processed in a batch operation, each defined by their ID and properties.

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectBatchInput items, each containing the properties and optional associations for a single object. This is used to specify the data for each object in the batch operation.

objects.quotes.batch.upsert.title: Create or update a batch of quotes by unique property values
objects.quotes.batch.upsert.description: Create or update a batch of quotes by unique property values Create or update records identified by a unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. `idProperty` query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object.

items.description: Represents an object used in batch upsert operations, containing an object’s unique identifier, its properties, and optionally the unique property name and a write trace ID.

inputs.description: An array of objects, each containing the data for a CRM object to be created or updated. Each object must include properties and may include an objectWriteTraceId, id, and idProperty.

objects.quotes.gdpr-delete.title: GDPR Delete
objects.quotes.gdpr-delete.description: GDPR Delete Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to comply with GDPR regulations. This endpoint allows you to specify an optional 'idProperty' set to 'email' to identify the contact by email address. If the email address is not found, it will be added to a blocklist to prevent future use.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object

objectId.description: The unique identifier for the object to be deleted. This is a required string property.

objects.quotes.merge.title: Merge objects
objects.quotes.merge.description: Merge objects Merge two CRM objects of the same type in your HubSpot account. This operation combines the properties and associations of the specified objects into a single object. Use this endpoint to streamline duplicate records and maintain data integrity.

objectIdToMerge.description: The unique identifier of the object that will be merged into the primary object. This is a string.

primaryObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the primary object that will remain after the merge. This is a string.

objects.quotes.search.title: Search for quotes using specified criteria.
objects.quotes.search.description: Search for quotes using specified criteria. Execute a search for quotes based on the criteria defined in the request body, such as filters, properties, and sorting options. This endpoint allows for detailed querying of quote records to retrieve specific data sets.

after.description: A string representing the paging cursor token to retrieve the next set of results.

items.description: Represents a group of filters used to query data within HubSpot. This component is used to define criteria for filtering records in various API endpoints.

filterGroups.description: An array of filter groups used to specify the criteria for the search. Each filter group contains a set of filters that are combined using logical AND.

limit.description: An integer specifying the maximum number of results to return.

properties.description: An array of strings specifying the properties to be returned in the search results.

query.description: A string representing the search query to be applied across the specified properties.

sorts.description: An array of strings indicating the fields and order by which the search results should be sorted.

objects.quotes.get.title: Read
objects.quotes.get.description: Read Read an Object identified by `{quoteId}`. `{quoteId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

associations.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

objects.quotes.delete.title: Archive
objects.quotes.delete.description: Archive Move an Object identified by `{quoteId}` to the recycling bin.

objects.quotes.update.title: Update
objects.quotes.update.description: Update Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{quoteId}`or optionally a unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. `{quoteId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, and the `idProperty` query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will result in an error. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs where each key is a property name and each value is the property's value. All properties must be strings.

objects.quotes.associations.list.title: List associations
objects.quotes.associations.list.description: List associations List all associations of an object by object type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations for a specified object, with a limit of 500 results per call. It is useful for understanding the relationships between different objects in your CRM.

toObjectType.description: The type of the associated objects to retrieve.

after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

crm-object-schemas.schemas.list.title: Retrieve all custom object schemas.
crm-object-schemas.schemas.list.description: Retrieve all custom object schemas. Retrieve all custom object schemas, with options to include property definitions, association definitions, and audit metadata.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

includeAssociationDefinitions.description: Whether to include association definitions in the response. Defaults to true.

includeAuditMetadata.description: Whether to include audit metadata in the response. Defaults to true.

includePropertyDefinitions.description: Whether to include property definitions in the response. Defaults to true.

crm-object-schemas.schemas.create.title: Create a new custom object schema.
crm-object-schemas.schemas.create.description: Create a new custom object schema. Create a new custom object schema by defining its properties and associations.

allowsSensitiveProperties.description: Determines if the object type can include properties that are marked as sensitive.

associatedObjects.description: Associations defined for this object type.

description.description: A brief explanation of the object type.

name.description: A unique name for this object. For internal use only.

primaryDisplayProperty.description: The name of the primary property for this object. This will be displayed as primary on the HubSpot record page for this object type.

properties.description: Properties defined for this object type.

requiredProperties.description: The names of properties that should be **required** when creating an object of this type.

searchableProperties.description: Names of properties that will be indexed for this object type in by HubSpot's product search.

secondaryDisplayProperties.description: The names of secondary properties for this object. These will be displayed as secondary on the HubSpot record page for this object type.

shouldCreateSameObjectAssociation.description: A boolean indicating whether associations should be created between objects of the same type.

crm-object-schemas.schemas.batch.read.title: Retrieve multiple custom object schemas in a batch request.
crm-object-schemas.schemas.batch.read.description: Retrieve multiple custom object schemas in a batch request. Retrieve details of multiple custom object schemas by providing a batch request with specified inputs. This operation allows you to fetch schema information, including properties and associations, for multiple custom objects in a single API call.

includeAssociationDefinitions.description: Indicates whether to include association definitions in the response.

includeAuditMetadata.description: Indicates whether to include audit metadata in the response.

includePropertyDefinitions.description: Indicates whether to include property definitions in the response.

inputs.description: An array of strings representing the identifiers of the object schemas to be read.

crm-object-schemas.schemas.list.objectty.title: Retrieve the schema of a specified custom object.
crm-object-schemas.schemas.list.objectty.description: Retrieve the schema of a specified custom object. Retrieve details of a custom object schema, including its properties and associations, using the object type ID or fully qualified name.

objectType.description: The unique identifier for the CRM object type whose schema is being retrieved.

includeAssociationDefinitions.description: A boolean indicating whether to include association definitions in the response. Defaults to true.

includeAuditMetadata.description: A boolean indicating whether to include audit metadata in the response. Defaults to true.

includePropertyDefinitions.description: A boolean indicating whether to include property definitions in the response. Defaults to true.

crm-object-schemas.schemas.delete.title: Delete the schema of a specified custom object.
crm-object-schemas.schemas.delete.description: Delete the schema of a specified custom object. Remove a custom object schema from the account using its object type ID or fully qualified name.

objectType.description: The unique identifier of the object schema to delete.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

crm-object-schemas.schemas.update.title: Update the schema of a specified custom object.
crm-object-schemas.schemas.update.description: Update the schema of a specified custom object. Update attributes of a custom object schema, such as properties and labels, using the object type ID or fully qualified name.

objectType.description: The unique identifier of the CRM object type whose schema is to be updated.

allowsSensitiveProperties.description: Determines if the object type can include properties that are marked as sensitive.

clearDescription.description: Indicates whether the description of the object type should be cleared.

description.description: A brief explanation of the object type.

primaryDisplayProperty.description: The name of the primary property for this object. This will be displayed as primary on the HubSpot record page for this object type.

requiredProperties.description: The names of properties that should be **required** when creating an object of this type.

restorable.description: Specifies if the object type can be restored after being deleted.

searchableProperties.description: Names of properties that will be indexed for this object type in by HubSpot's product search.

secondaryDisplayProperties.description: The names of secondary properties for this object. These will be displayed as secondary on the HubSpot record page for this object type.

crm-object-schemas.schemas.associations..title: Create an association for a specified object type.
crm-object-schemas.schemas.associations..description: Create an association for a specified object type. Create a new association between the specified object type and another object type. This operation requires the definition of the association attributes, such as the primary and target object type IDs.

objectType.description: The unique identifier of the object type for which the association is being created.

fromObjectTypeId.description: ID of the primary object type to link from.

name.description: A unique name for this association.

toObjectTypeId.description: ID of the target object type ID to link to.

crm-object-schemas.schemas.associations..title: Delete an existing association for a specified object type.
crm-object-schemas.schemas.associations..description: Delete an existing association for a specified object type. Remove an association between two object types identified by the association identifier and object type. This operation is irreversible and will permanently delete the specified association.

associationIdentifier.description: The unique identifier of the association definition to delete.

objectType.description: The type of the custom object from which the association is being deleted.

objects.0-162.list.title: List
objects.0-162.list.description: List Retrieve a page of CRM objects of a specified type. You can control the data returned by specifying which properties to include using the `properties` query parameter. This endpoint supports pagination and allows you to filter results based on archived status.

after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

associations.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

properties.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

objects.0-162.create.title: Create
objects.0-162.create.description: Create Create a CRM object with the specified properties and return a copy of the object, including its ID. This endpoint allows you to create standard objects in your HubSpot account, providing documentation and examples for guidance.

items.description: Represents the associations for a specific object in HubSpot, detailing the types of associations and the related objects involved.

associations.description: An array of objects that define associations between the CRM object being created and other existing objects. Each association specifies the related object and the type of association.

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs where each key is a property name and each value is the property's value. These properties define the attributes of the CRM object being created.

objects.0-162.batch.archive.title: Batch archive objects
objects.0-162.batch.archive.description: Batch archive objects Archive a batch of CRM objects by their IDs. This operation moves the specified objects to the recycling bin, effectively archiving them. Use this endpoint to manage large numbers of objects that need to be archived simultaneously.

items.description: Contains the Id of a Public Object

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectId objects, each representing the ID of a CRM object to be processed. This property is required.

objects.0-162.batch.create.title: Batch create objects
objects.0-162.batch.create.description: Batch create objects Create a batch of CRM objects of a specified type in HubSpot. This endpoint allows you to create multiple objects in a single request, streamlining the process of populating your CRM with new data. Each object must include the necessary properties for creation.

items.description: An input object that contains a collection of objects to be created together in a batch.

inputs.description: An array of objects, each conforming to the SimplePublicObjectBatchInputForCreate schema, representing the CRM objects to be created in the batch. Each object includes properties and associations necessary for creation.

objects.0-162.batch.read.title: Read batch objects
objects.0-162.batch.read.description: Read batch objects Retrieve a batch of CRM objects by their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint is useful for fetching multiple objects at once, allowing you to specify whether to include archived objects in the response.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

idProperty.description: When using a custom unique value property to retrieve records, the name of the property. Do not include this parameter if retrieving by record ID.

items.description: Contains the Id of a Public Object

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectId objects, each representing the ID of an object to be read.

properties.description: An array of strings specifying the properties to be returned for each object. If a specified property is not present on an object, it will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: An array of strings specifying the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If a specified property is not present on an object, it will be ignored.

objects.0-162.batch.update.title: Update batch objects
objects.0-162.batch.update.description: Update batch objects Update a batch of CRM objects in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify multiple objects at once by providing their details in the request body. It's useful for making bulk updates to object properties efficiently.

items.description: Contains an array of CRM object records to be processed in a batch operation, each defined by their ID and properties.

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectBatchInput objects, each containing the properties and identifiers needed for updating a specific CRM object.

objects.0-162.batch.upsert.title: Upsert batch objects
objects.0-162.batch.upsert.description: Upsert batch objects Create or update a batch of CRM objects in HubSpot using unique property values. This endpoint allows you to efficiently manage multiple objects by either creating new entries or updating existing ones based on the specified properties.

items.description: Represents an object used in batch upsert operations, containing an object’s unique identifier, its properties, and optionally the unique property name and a write trace ID.

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectBatchInputUpsert objects, each containing the data for a single object to be created or updated.

objects.0-162.search.title: Search objects
objects.0-162.search.description: Search objects Search CRM objects of a specified type using various filters and criteria. This endpoint allows you to query objects based on their properties and return results that match the specified search criteria. It is useful for retrieving specific subsets of data from your CRM system.

after.description: A string representing the paging cursor token to use for fetching the next set of results.

items.description: Represents a group of filters used to query data within HubSpot. This component is used to define criteria for filtering records in various API endpoints.

filterGroups.description: An array of filter groups to apply to the search. Each filter group contains a set of filters that are combined using a logical AND operation.

limit.description: An integer specifying the maximum number of results to return.

properties.description: An array of strings specifying which properties of the objects should be included in the search results.

query.description: A string representing a search query to match against object properties.

sorts.description: An array of strings specifying the sorting criteria for the search results. Each string represents a property to sort by, optionally prefixed with a '-' to indicate descending order.

objects.0-162.get.title: Read
objects.0-162.get.description: Read Read an object identified by `objectId`. By default, `objectId` refers to the internal object ID, but it can also be any unique property value specified by the `idProperty` query parameter. The response can be customized using the `properties` query parameter to include specific object properties.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

associations.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

objects.0-162.delete.title: Archive
objects.0-162.delete.description: Archive Move an Object identified by `{objectId}` to the recycling bin. This operation allows you to archive a specific CRM object of a given type, identified by its unique ID.

objects.0-162.update.title: Update
objects.0-162.update.description: Update Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{objectId}`. `{objectId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs where each key is a property name and each value is the property's value. The properties are used to define or update the attributes of the CRM object.

objects.services.gdpr-delete.title: GDPR Delete
objects.services.gdpr-delete.description: GDPR Delete Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to comply with GDPR regulations. You can use the optional 'idProperty' set to 'email' to identify the contact by email address. If the email address is not found, it will be added to a blocklist, preventing future use.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object

objectId.description: The unique identifier of the object to be deleted.

objects.services.merge.title: Merge objects
objects.services.merge.description: Merge objects Merge two CRM objects of the same type in your HubSpot account. This operation combines the properties and associations of the specified objects into a single object, identified by the primary object ID. Use this endpoint to consolidate duplicate records or unify data under a single entity.

objectIdToMerge.description: The ID of the object that will be merged into the primary object.

primaryObjectId.description: The ID of the object that will remain as the primary object after the merge.

objects.services.associations.list.title: List associations
