id.description: The unique identifier for this event occurrence, represented as a string.

objectId.description: The unique identifier of the object related to the event, represented as a string.

objectTypeFullyQualifiedName.description: The fully qualified name of the object type associated with the event, represented as a string.

properties.description: A map of custom property names to their values, represented as an object with string values.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the event occurred, represented in ISO 8601 format.

utk.description: The user token key (utk) associated with the event, represented as a string.

integrators.timeline.events.batch.create.title: Batch insert events
integrators.timeline.events.batch.create.description: Batch insert events Insert a batch of new App Event occurrences into the timeline. Each occurrence in the batch is immutable, and if an occurrence with the same ID already exists, the entire batch will be rejected. The batch can include occurrences from multiple event types, but all must belong to a single portal.

inputs.description: An array of AppEventOccurrence objects, each representing an individual app event occurrence to be included in the batch. This property is required.

integrators.timeline.types.projects.crea.title: Resolve Event Type
integrators.timeline.types.projects.crea.description: Resolve Event Type Resolve the fully qualified name (FQN) of an App Event Type using its developer coordinates, which include the project name and developer symbol. This endpoint is used for event types managed through Projects and does not support legacy or non-migrated event types.

developerSymbol.description: The developer symbol used to identify the App Event Type. It is a string.

projectName.description: The name of the project associated with the App Event Type. It is a string.

extensions.calling.transcripts.create.title: Create Transcript
extensions.calling.transcripts.create.description: Create Transcript Create a new transcript for a call in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to submit the details of a call transcript, including engagement ID and utterances, to be stored and managed within HubSpot. This is useful for integrating call transcription data into your CRM workflows.

engagementId.description: The unique identifier for the engagement associated with this transcript. It is an integer in int64 format.

transcriptCreateUtterances.description: An array of utterances that make up the transcript. Each utterance is represented by a TranscriptCreateUtterance object.

extensions.calling.transcripts.get.title: Retrieve transcript
extensions.calling.transcripts.get.description: Retrieve transcript Retrieve a specific call transcript by its unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to access the details of a transcript, including its creation and update timestamps, engagement ID, source, and the transcript utterances. It is useful for reviewing and analyzing call interactions stored in your HubSpot account.

transcriptId.description: The unique identifier of the transcript to retrieve.

extensions.calling.transcripts.delete.title: Delete transcript
extensions.calling.transcripts.delete.description: Delete transcript Delete a specific call transcript from your HubSpot account using its unique identifier. This operation is useful for managing and cleaning up transcript data that is no longer needed.

transcriptId.description: The unique identifier of the transcript to delete.

objects.users.list.title: List
objects.users.list.description: List Read a page of users. Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

associations.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

properties.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

objects.users.create.title: Create
objects.users.create.description: Create Create a user with the given properties and return a copy of the object, including the ID. Documentation and examples for creating standard users is provided.

items.description: Represents the associations for a specific object in HubSpot, detailing the types of associations and the related objects involved.

associations.description: An array of objects that define the associations between the new CRM object and other objects. Each association specifies the target object and the types of relationships.

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs where each key is a property name and each value is the property's value. The properties define the attributes of the CRM object being created.

objects.users.batch.archive.title: Archive a batch of users by ID
objects.users.batch.archive.description: Archive a batch of users by ID Archive multiple users by their IDs in a single request. This operation moves the specified users to the recycling bin, effectively deactivating them from active use.

items.description: Contains the Id of a Public Object

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectId objects, each representing the ID of a CRM object to be processed in the batch operation.

objects.users.batch.create.title: Create a batch of users
objects.users.batch.create.description: Create a batch of users Create multiple users in a single request by providing a batch of user properties and associations. This endpoint returns the created users along with their IDs.

items.description: An input object that contains a collection of objects to be created together in a batch.

inputs.description: An array of objects to be created, each defined by the SimplePublicObjectBatchInputForCreate schema.

objects.users.batch.read.title: Read a batch of users by internal ID, or unique property values
objects.users.batch.read.description: Read a batch of users by internal ID, or unique property values Retrieve records by record ID or include the `idProperty` parameter to retrieve records by a custom unique value property.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

idProperty.description: When using a custom unique value property to retrieve records, the name of the property. Do not include this parameter if retrieving by record ID.

items.description: Contains the Id of a Public Object

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectId objects, each representing an object to be read.

properties.description: An array of strings specifying the properties to be returned in the response. If any specified properties are not present on the requested objects, they will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: An array of strings specifying the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any specified properties are not present on the requested objects, they will be ignored.

objects.users.batch.update.title: Update a batch of users by internal ID, or unique property values
objects.users.batch.update.description: Update a batch of users by internal ID, or unique property values Update multiple user records in a single request by specifying their internal IDs or unique property values. This operation allows for batch processing of user data, ensuring efficient updates across multiple user profiles.

items.description: Contains an array of CRM object records to be processed in a batch operation, each defined by their ID and properties.

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectBatchInput objects, each representing a single CRM object input to be processed in the batch operation.

objects.users.batch.upsert.title: Create or update a batch of users by unique property values
objects.users.batch.upsert.description: Create or update a batch of users by unique property values Create or update records identified by a unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. `idProperty` query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object.

items.description: Represents an object used in batch upsert operations, containing an object’s unique identifier, its properties, and optionally the unique property name and a write trace ID.

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectBatchInputUpsert objects, each containing the properties and identifiers necessary for creating or updating a CRM object. This array is required.

objects.users.gdpr-delete.title: GDPR Delete
objects.users.gdpr-delete.description: GDPR Delete Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to comply with GDPR regulations. You can use the optional 'idProperty' set to 'email' to identify the contact by email address. If the email address is not found, it will be added to a blocklist to prevent future use.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object

objectId.description: The unique identifier of the object to be deleted. This is a required field and must be a string.

objects.users.merge.title: Merge objects
objects.users.merge.description: Merge objects Merge two CRM objects of the same type in your HubSpot account. This operation combines the properties and associations of the two specified objects into a single object, identified by the primary object ID.

objectIdToMerge.description: The unique identifier of the object that will be merged into the primary object. This is a string.

primaryObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the primary object that will remain after the merge. This is a string.

objects.users.search.title: Search for users based on specified criteria.
objects.users.search.description: Search for users based on specified criteria. Execute a search for users using defined filters, properties, and sorting options. The request must include a search query and can return up to 200 results per request.

after.description: A string used as a paging cursor token to retrieve results after a specific point.

items.description: Represents a group of filters used to query data within HubSpot. This component is used to define criteria for filtering records in various API endpoints.

filterGroups.description: An array of FilterGroup objects that define the criteria for filtering the search results.

limit.description: An integer specifying the maximum number of results to return.

properties.description: An array of strings indicating the properties to be included in the search results.

query.description: A string representing the search query to be applied.

sorts.description: An array of strings specifying the sorting order of the search results.

objects.users.get.title: Read
objects.users.get.description: Read Read an Object identified by `{userId}`. `{userId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

associations.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

objects.users.delete.title: Archive
objects.users.delete.description: Archive Move an Object identified by `{userId}` to the recycling bin.

objects.users.update.title: Update
objects.users.update.description: Update Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{userId}`or optionally a unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. `{userId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, and the `idProperty` query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will result in an error. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

idProperty.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs representing the properties of the CRM object to be updated. Each key is a property name, and each value is the new value for that property. All properties are expected to be strings.

objects.users.associations.list.title: List associations
objects.users.associations.list.description: List associations List all associations of a specified object by its type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations between different object types, with a limit of 500 associations per call. It is useful for understanding relationships between objects in your CRM.

toObjectType.description: The type of the object to which associations are being listed.

after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

extensions.videoconferencing.settings.ge.title: Get settings
extensions.videoconferencing.settings.ge.description: Get settings Fetch video conference extension settings for your app

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app whose video conferencing settings you want to retrieve. It should be an integer.

extensions.videoconferencing.settings.re.title: Create or update settings
extensions.videoconferencing.settings.re.description: Create or update settings Create or update video conference extension settings for your app

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app whose video conferencing settings are to be updated.

createMeetingUrl.description: A string representing the URL used to create a new meeting. This property is required.

deleteMeetingUrl.description: A string representing the URL used to delete a meeting.

fetchAccountsUri.description: A string representing the URI used to fetch account information.

updateMeetingUrl.description: A string representing the URL used to update an existing meeting.

userVerifyUrl.description: A string representing the URL used to verify a user's identity.

extensions.videoconferencing.settings.de.title: Delete settings
extensions.videoconferencing.settings.de.description: Delete settings Delete video conference extension settings for your app

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app whose video conferencing settings are to be deleted. It must be an integer.
